head.h1: Afternoon Tea Catering in Dubai — Prices, Formats and What You Get

opening_paragraph: Afternoon tea catering Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person, with tiered stands, pots poured at the table and a chef who plates, serves and clears. Give us your date, guest count and venue, we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with a full itemised quote to follow: finger sandwiches, warm scones, patisserie and a curated tea list, all designed around your occasion and any dietary needs.

new_paragraphs: How much does afternoon tea catering cost in Dubai?

From AED 700 per person, quoted to your guest count, menu and service. Buffet-style sits at the lower end; plated tiered service with staff sits higher. Set packages from AED 1,200 suit fixed numbers. Send your details for an itemised quote.
What is included in afternoon tea catering?
Included is a vetted chef, service staff where needed, tiered stands, china, plating, setup and cleanup, plus bespoke menu design from the first conversation. You host; we handle the rest.
How far ahead should I book afternoon tea catering in Dubai?
Book about a week ahead for a small gathering. Allow two to four weeks for weddings, large parties and peak dates such as Mother's Day and December, when the top chefs book up fastest.
Can you cater afternoon tea for corporate events and parties?
Yes. Corporate afternoon tea catering in Dubai covers client hospitality and team celebrations, plus bridal showers, birthdays and private parties, scaled from an intimate table to a large reception.
Do you offer vegan, gluten-free and halal afternoon tea options?

Yes. Vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and nut-conscious menus may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner, and meat is prepared to halal standards. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, so share dietary needs in full when you enquire and the chef designs around them.
Can I get afternoon tea catering near me across Dubai?
Yes. We cover the whole city, from Palm Jumeirah and Jumeirah to Downtown, Dubai Marina, Business Bay and DIFC, serving villas, apartments, offices and gardens.
Do you offer afternoon tea catering packages?
Yes. Per-head pricing suits most events, while set packages from AED 1,200 work well for fixed guest counts and budgets. We will point you to whichever gives better value.
For afternoon tea catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

new_paragraphs: Afternoon tea catering includes the food, the format and the full service: a three-tier spread of savouries, scones and pastries, plus a chef on site, service staff, tiered stands, china and linen, setup and cleanup. You host; we carry the work. As a full afternoon tea catering services provider, myCHEF designs the menu with you, brings everything the table needs and leaves the space as we found it. Unlike a bakery drop-off, a private afternoon tea chef finishes scones warm, whips cream fresh and paces the tea service so nothing sits and dries out. Whether it is a quiet gathering for eight or a large celebration, one team owns the timing from the first pot to the last plate. Every afternoon tea catering company in Dubai promises elegance; our difference is a vetted chef standing behind the stand, not just a delivery van at the door.

new_paragraphs: This is the working list the chefs build from, set out in the order a tea is served: something poured, then savoury, then scones, then sweet. Nobody takes all of it. A three-tier stand carries four or five items per tier, a grazing table spreads wider and flatter, and a drop-off order narrows to what travels without wilting. Send the occasion, the guest count and the date, and a shortlist comes back against it.
How the tea is set out
Format decides the equipment, the staffing and half the cost, so it is worth settling before the food.
Three-tier stand service: poured at the table, roughly one stand per two guests
Continental spread on a plattered side credenza: no hot line, the boardroom-morning default
Grazing table: styled down the length of the room, wider and flatter than a stand
Drop-off platters and gathering boxes: sold by the number of persons served
Grab-and-go bar: pre-wrapped items near the entrance, eaten with one hand
High tea on-the-go: a takeaway stand for guests leaving with a box
Coffee-break format: a coffee station and pastry display for a 30 to 45 minute break
Plated brunch service: three to seven courses, seated
Bowl-and-fork standing service: for rooms where there is no seating
Live chef-manned stations: added on top of the stands, not instead of them
The welcome pour, before anything is eaten
One cold drink in hand while guests find their seats. Two or three is plenty.
Classic lemonade: lightly sweet, the safe default in the heat
Watermelon juice
Freshly squeezed orange juice
Berry fruit drink
Cold-pressed detox juices: green or beetroot-led, pressed the same morning
Infused water station: cucumber, mint and citrus, refilled through the service
Still and sparkling water

The bottom tier, eaten first, crusts off and halved. Four to six varieties is the market standard and the point at which a tea stops feeling thin.
Egg mayonnaise finger sandwiches: the one guests reach for first

Where the tea is replacing lunch, or the brief is a wedding, the savoury tier is built from canapés and small bowls instead of sandwiches. Five to ten cold, six to eight hot.

Reading the menu: dietary flags and lead time

Vegetarian items are flagged (V) on the line itself, not pushed into a separate menu, and a vegan tea is built from coconut yoghurt, nut milks and vegan baked goods instead of by subtraction. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.

On timing: we recommend booking as early as possible. Lead times depend on guest numbers, menu complexity, staffing, equipment, location and partner availability. Late afternoon tea enquiries are assessed one by one against real partner availability for the date. As guidance, a bespoke tea menu sits around five to seven days out, live stations three to five days, and a wedding or large corporate function seven to fourteen days or more.

The afternoon tea menu is bespoke, built around three classic tiers you can push in any direction. A typical spread runs finger sandwiches and savouries (smoked salmon, cucumber, coronation chicken, egg mayonnaise), then warm plain and fruit scones with clotted cream and preserves, up to a top tier of French patisserie, tarts, macarons and seasonal fruit. The tea list is curated too: classic blacks, greens, herbal infusions and a caffeine-free option, with coffee and a mocktail or sparkling toast on request. As afternoon tea food catering, every item is prepared fresh for your date instead of pulled from a shelf. Want a savoury-led tea for a corporate room, a pastel dessert-heavy table for a shower, or an Arabic-influenced twist with dates and rosewater? The chef adapts the menu to your taste, your guests and the season.

new_paragraphs: Afternoon tea flexes to nearly any occasion — corporate hospitality, showers, birthdays and weddings all suit the format. Corporate afternoon tea catering in Dubai works beautifully for client entertaining, team milestones and boardroom celebrations, where a refined spread signals care without the weight of a full lunch. For social hosts, afternoon tea party catering turns a bridal shower, baby shower or milestone birthday into something unhurried and photogenic. At weddings, a tiered tea moment makes a graceful pre-ceremony welcome or a relaxed morning-after brunch alternative. Because it is afternoon tea catering built for events of every size, we scale the same menu from an intimate eight-seat table to a hundred-plus guest reception, adjusting staff, stands and station count to match. Tell us the headcount and the mood, whether polished corporate, playful shower or romantic wedding, and the menu and styling follow.
